# kalman_filter { #jaxidem.filters.kalman_filter }

```python
filters.kalman_filter(
    m_0,
    P_0,
    M,
    PHI,
    sigma2_eta,
    sigma2_eps,
    zs_tree,
    sigma2_eta_dim,
    sigma2_eps_dim,
    forecast=0,
    likelihood='partial',
)
```

The standard Kalman Filter.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type      | Description                                   | Default    |
|--------|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|------------|
| m_0    | ArrayLike | Prior mean of the filter at the 0 time point. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description   |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | A namedtuple containing the results of the filter. |               |
